title: Video Editing in DaVinci Resolve
description:
DaVinci Resolve is a professional-grade video editing software used in film, television, and online media production. It combines editing, color correction, audio post-production, visual effects, and motion graphics in one powerful platform. The free version of DaVinci Resolve offers an impressive range of tools that are more than enough for most creative projects. From cutting and trimming to adding transitions, effects, and color grading, the free version supports high-quality workflows without limitations for beginners and intermediate users.
